name: strike-swap
title: StrikeSwap
description: A word gets struck out and its replacement springs in.

accessibility: Uses real <del> and <ins>, so assistive tech can tell which word was removed and which replaced it.
The struck word stays readable; the new word is not conveyed by colour alone.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the final strike and word without motion.
